{"consolidated_memory":"**CONSOLIDATED MEMORY: Recurring Dropped Rows Issue in ingest/pipeline/dedupe.py**

This is a chronological record of six separate occasions where dropped rows appeared in the dedupe stage (output count < input count) when running the pipeline over overlapping day partitions. All were fixed and verified with tests/ingest/test_dedupe.py. Stack: Python.

**OCCASION 1 – [2026-02-03] c006-e1: Timezone-Aware Datetime Mismatch**
- Trigger: Only for users sitting in negative UTC offset
- Root cause: A naive datetime was being compared against an aware datetime
- Fix: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR: #2222 on branch fix/dropped-rows-2
- Measured outcome: Reclaimed 73 GB of blob storage

**OCCASION 2 – [2026-04-02] c006-e3: Missing Composite Index**
- Trigger: Only when two requests raced on the same key
- Root cause: Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- Fix: Added the composite index and backfilled in batches
- PR: #5517 on branch fix/dropped-rows-4
- Measured outcome: 79 duplicate rows per day stopped being written

**OCCASION 3 – [2026-04-27] c006-e4: Connection Pool Exhaustion**
- Trigger: Only on the first request after a cold start
- Root cause: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: Raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR: #5590 on branch fix/dropped-rows-5
- Measured outcome: p99 latency fell from 9.2 s to 879 ms

**OCCASION 4 – [2026-05-30] c006-e5: Unbounded Retry Loop**
- Trigger: Only after a rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: Unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: Capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR: #7559 on branch fix/dropped-rows-6
- Measured outcome: Job finished in 26 minutes instead of 9 hours

**OCCASION 5 – [2026-06-03] c006-e6: Serialiser Dropping Unknown Fields**
- Trigger: Only for payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: The serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Fix: Switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- PR: #7935 on branch fix/dropped-rows-7
- Measured outcome: Cold start dropped 35 percent, to 754 ms

**OCCASION 6 – [2026-06-23] c006-e7: Config Loader Reading Wrong Environment File**
- Trigger: Only for tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Root cause: The config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR: #8438 on branch fix/dropped-rows-8
- Measured outcome: The backlog cleared 90 minutes after the deploy"}
